Description: Unique identifier for the claim.
Notes: Also used as join key to Documents_OCR.

Description: Unique identifier for the claimant/policyholder.
Notes: One customer can have multiple claims.

Description: Insurance policy number linked to the claim.
Age of the claimant in years.
Claimant's recorded gender.
Geographic region of the claimant.
Type of insurance policy held.
Annual/periodic premium paid by the customer (N$).
Total coverage amount of the policy (N$).
Amount claimed by the customer (N$).
Category of the insurance claim.
Claimant's credit score.
Pre-computed composite fraud-risk score for the claim.
Notes: Descriptive/legacy score from the source dataset; not the model's output score.

Description: Ground-truth label: whether the claim was confirmed fraudulent.
Current administrative status of the claim.
Amount actually settled/paid out on the claim (N$).
Date and time the claim was filed.
Notes: Stored as text; parse with pandas.to_datetime.

Description: ID of the staff member/agent who processed the claim.
Whether the claimant's identity/KYC profile was changed before the claim.
Notes: Dominant feature in the fraud model (~46% importance).

Description: Date of the most recent KYC/identity update, if one occurred.
Notes: Only populated when Identity_Changed_Flag = 1 (blank = no update).

Description: Number of days between the KYC update and the claim date.
Whether the claimant's address changed recently (enrichment feature).
Notes: From conditional enrichment match, not a real per-row join - see linkage_summary.txt.

Description: Number of previous claims filed by the customer (enrichment feature).
Whether a witness was present for the claimed incident.
Notes: '*' values (0.68% of rows) are a data-quality artefact from the source file, imputed with the column mode during modelling.

Description: Whether a police report was filed for the claim.
Safety rating associated with the claim/asset (enrichment feature).
Number of days the claim file has been open.
Number of defects/errors found on the claim form.
Channel through which the claim was submitted.
Unique identifier for the staff member/agent.
Full name of the staff member.
Date the employee joined the company.
First line of the employee's address.
Second line of the employee's address (unit/suite).
Notes: Blank when no secondary address line exists.

Description: City of residence.
State/province abbreviation.
Postal/ZIP code.
Total number of claims this staff member has handled.
Notes: Derived by aggregating Claims_KYC on Handled_By_Staff_ID.

Description: Number of those claims that were confirmed fraudulent.
Proportion of the staff member's claims that were fraudulent.
Department the employee belongs to.
Office campus/site of the employee.
Job title/position of the employee.
Years of seniority/experience at the company.
Whether the person is a contractor rather than a permanent employee.
Internal classification/clearance tier of the employee.
Notes: Higher tiers imply broader system access in the source dataset's schema.

Description: Whether the employee holds foreign citizenship.
Whether the employee has a recorded criminal history.
Whether the employee has a flagged medical history record.
Notes: Insider-threat behavioural indicator; sensitive field, access-restricted.

Description: Employee's country of origin.
Total pages printed by the employee (activity log).
Pages printed outside normal working hours.
Total files written to removable/optical media.
Whether files were burned from another user's workstation.
Whether the employee was travelling abroad during the observation period.
Day number within a foreign trip, if applicable.
Risk classification of the country visited/associated with.
Number of physical building/campus entries recorded.
Number of distinct campuses the employee accessed.
Whether the employee exited the building unusually late.
Whether the employee entered the building on a weekend.
Ground-truth label: whether the employee is flagged as an insider risk.
Timestamp of a recorded claim-record access event by this staff member.
Notes: One representative access event per agent, not a full multi-event access log (documented limitation).

Description: Claim_ID of the record accessed during the logged event.
Notes: Blank rows indicate no logged access event for that agent.

Description: Type of system override performed, if any, during the access event.
Valid Values / Range: No override recorded, Approved above authority limit, Unscheduled record access, Bypassed secondary verification

Description: Outcome of any internal investigation into the staff member.
Valid Values / Range: No findings, Unsubstantiated, Under investigation, Confirmed - insider risk

Description: Unique identifier for the uploaded document.
Customer associated with the document.
Claim the document was uploaded in support of.
Date and time the document was uploaded.
File format of the uploaded document.
File size in kilobytes.
Category of document content.
Notes: Classified with 100% accuracy - see documented limitation on synthetic OCR text below.

Description: Extracted OCR/text content of the document.
Example Value: NATIONAL IDENTITY DOCUMENT. Full Name: Allison Hill...
Notes: Synthetically generated from fixed templates per document_type - not real scanned OCR (documented limitation in nlp_report.txt).

Description: ID grouping documents with near-identical/templated content.
Notes: Blank = document is not part of a detected duplicate cluster.

Description: Whether this document's claim also had an identity/KYC change.
Notes: 77 of 220 documents linked to an identity-changed claim.

Description: Text-similarity score against other documents (0 = unique, 1 = identical).
Notes: Computed via text-similarity analysis in the NLP module.

Description: Banded version of document_similarity_score.
Unique identifier for the login event.
Customer who performed the login.
Date and time of the login attempt.
Identifier of the device used to log in.
Whether this device had not been seen for this customer before.
IP address of the login attempt.
Notes: Synthetic; not a real customer IP.

Description: City the login was geolocated to.
Whether the login location is unusual for this customer's history.
Type of network the login originated from.
Valid Values / Range: Public Wi-Fi, Mobile Data, Home Wi-Fi, VPN

Description: Outcome of the authentication attempt.
Number of failed login attempts before this successful one.
Whether the login occurred outside standard business hours (22:00-06:00).
